## How it works

- Requirements. MW, density, region, and go-live date.

- Path. The fastest existing site for your load.

- Move in. Terms, access, fiber, fit-out.

- Live. Racks live on the date we give you.

## Agents do the legwork.

They search sites, confirm spare power and cooling, check fiber and access, pull quotes and lead times, and model your schedule.

## Existing capacity, matched to you.

Tell us the MW, region, and go-live date. Agents find powered capacity that already exists, verify it, and set the date. You bring the GPUs.

- Modeling . Your requirements in. Site, go-live date, and critical path out.

- Sites . Existing sites with power and cooling available now, scored by months to first MW.

- Power . Contracted MW, substation capacity, and redundancy, checked per site.

- Cooling and density . Air, rear-door, or direct-to-chip liquid, matched to your kW per rack.

- Fiber and access . Two diverse carriers where required, plus access, security, and remote-hands terms.

- Terms . Capacity, term, and monthly pricing for the MW you need.
